To give a gift to UM-Dearborn starting from https://umich.edu/, you can navigate using either of the following paths:

### Method 1: Via the Michigan Giving Portal
1. From https://umich.edu/, click on **Giving** in the main navigation menu (leading to https://umich.edu/giving/).
2. Under "Michigan Giving", click **Make a Gift to U-M** (https://giving.umich.edu/um/), then select **Make a Gift** in the top navigation (https://giving.umich.edu/um/make-a-gift).
3. On the Make a Gift page, go to the **Search and Filter** sidebar on the left.
4. Under the **Around our Campuses** filter section, check the box for **UM-Dearborn**.
5. Browse the available UM-Dearborn funds (such as the general **Fund for UM-Dearborn - 301955**, college-specific annual funds, or student support funds).
6. Click **Give Now** next to your chosen fund to add it to your Giving Basket, choose your gift frequency (one-time or monthly) and amount, and proceed through checkout.

---

### Method 2: Via the UM-Dearborn Campus Site
1. From https://umich.edu/, scroll down to the footer and click on **Dearborn** (https://umdearborn.edu/).
2. On the UM-Dearborn homepage, click **Giving** in the header navigation (https://umdearborn.edu/giving).
3. Click the **Give Now** button, which directs straight to the filtered UM-Dearborn funds on the central giving portal (https://giving.umich.edu/um/make-a-gift#!um%2Ddearborn), or explore **Ways to Give** (https://umdearborn.edu/giving/ways-give) for options including online credit card gifts, checks by mail, planned gifts, and employer matching.
